recognize_zh: 並列的 CD4 與 CD8 染色：CD8 在腺窩之間的固有層呈瀰漫強陽性，CD4 只有零星散在細胞，呈現明顯 CD8 優勢，是 CD8+ 惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的典型免疫表型。
features: CD8: dense, diffuse strong staining filling the lamina propria between crypts
CD4: only scattered positive cells (likely residual T cells and histiocytes)
Marked CD8-over-CD4 predominance in the infiltrate
Crypts preserved and negative, separated by the expanded infiltrate
describe_en: Side-by-side CD4 and CD8 immunostains of colonic mucosa at low power show that the expanded lamina propria infiltrate is diffusely and strongly CD8-positive, while CD4 highlights only scattered cells. The crypts are preserved and separated by the infiltrate. This marked CD8 predominance indicates a monotypic cytotoxic T-cell population and is consistent with CD8-positive indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: The CD4-positive variant shows the reverse pattern with diffuse CD4 and sparse CD8 staining.
Reactive lamina propria T cells show a mixed CD4 and CD8 population, typically CD4-predominant.
MEITL is also often CD8-positive but is CD56-positive, epitheliotropic and highly proliferative.
